name: GitHub MCP Server
summary: GitHub's official MCP server connecting AI agents to repos, issues, pull requests, Actions and code search.
description: The GitHub MCP Server connects AI agents, assistants and chatbots to GitHub: repository management, issue and PR automation, Actions and CI insights, code and security analysis, discussions and notifications. Run the GitHub-hosted remote server or a local binary/Docker image, pick toolsets, and authenticate with OAuth or a personal access token; read-only and lockdown modes reduce risk.
contains: remote server hosted by GitHub plus local Docker and Go builds
toolsets for repos, issues, PRs, Actions, code scanning, discussions and notifications
read-only and lockdown modes for safer agent access
OAuth or personal access token authentication
install guides for VS Code Copilot, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed and more
